recipes.name: Swiss Grid × Bauhaus Geometry × Y2K Cyber Fashion
recipes.layout: Swiss grid for information zones; asymmetric character zone with controlled overlap.
geometry: geometric decomposition of hair locks, garment hems and shoulder lines
risks: grid and collage may conflict; separate zones
do not alter character identity
recipes.prompt: character editorial poster, Swiss grid typography, Bauhaus geometric decomposition, Y2K cyber fashion accents, asymmetric layout, restrained chrome and translucent materials, preserve original character identity
aliases: 国际主义平面设计 × 包豪斯几何 × Y2K 赛博时装拼贴

recipes.name: Art Nouveau × Art Deco × Fantasy Portrait
recipes.layout: Central portrait with organic frame and stepped geometric border.
geometry: organic botanical curves and whiplash framing
stepped Art Deco outer borders and fan symmetry
risks: ornamental frame must not overpower face
recipes.prompt: ornate fantasy character portrait, Art Nouveau organic floral framing, Art Deco geometric symmetry, refined antique gold accents, elegant negative space, preserve character identity

recipes.name: Pop Art × Risograph × Comic Collage
recipes.layout: Comic panels or repeated subject with separate speech-bubble zone.
risks: keep eyes and facial expression free of halftone
recipes.prompt: playful character poster, Pop Art comic halftone, Risograph spot-color overprint, bold outlines, layered comic collage, expressive pose

recipes.name: Constructivism × Brutalist Graphic
recipes.layout: One dominant diagonal or radial structure; monumental typography.
geometry: wedges, rings, and hard-cropped rectangular blocks
risks: avoid multiple competing diagonals
recipes.prompt: constructivist graphic poster, bold diagonal composition, red black cream palette, monumental typography, brutalist editorial structure, print grain

recipes.name: Frutiger Aero × Glassmorphism
recipes.layout: Open translucent background with a few floating glass objects.
geometry: spherical bubbles, water droplets, and smooth arcs
risks: preserve text contrast; avoid excessive blur
recipes.prompt: optimistic futuristic visual, Frutiger Aero aesthetic, clear blue sky and aqua green, translucent glass bubbles, water droplets, soft sunlight, clean readable composition

recipes.name: Surrealist Collage × Editorial Design
recipes.layout: Editorial grid with one surreal focal metaphor.
geometry: dislocated scale and nested photographic silhouettes
risks: every spatial disruption should support a concept
recipes.prompt: surrealist editorial collage, impossible scale relationships, conceptual visual metaphor, refined magazine grid, controlled negative space, tactile photographic cutouts

recipes.name: Cut-out Collage × Swiss Typography
recipes.layout: Layered character silhouette with grid-aligned title.
risks: do not damage hair, fingers or garment silhouette
recipes.prompt: layered cut-paper character collage, Swiss editorial typography, torn paper edges, precise grid, overlapping cutout shapes, preserve silhouette and facial identity

recipes.name: Glitch Art × Swiss Typography
recipes.layout: Clean Swiss typographic grid for readable metadata; controlled horizontal slicing and signal disruption on the focal image.
geometry: horizontal pixel-slice bands and fractured grid blocks
palette: localized RGB channel split (electric blue, magenta, acid green)
risks: keep face and key identity anchors undistorted
keep critical typography on a clean unglitched layer
avoid high-frequency flashing in motion variants
recipes.prompt: digital editorial poster, controlled Glitch Art horizontal slicing and subtle RGB channel shift, clean Swiss sans-serif typography grid on separate unglitched layer, preserve facial identity and readable hierarchy

recipes.name: De Stijl × Swiss Grid
recipes.layout: Strict orthogonal black-line grid dividing asymmetric rectangular planes; Swiss sans-serif metadata aligned to grid borders.
risks: do not add diagonal chaos or gradients
keep character identity clear if used for character attribute cards
recipes.prompt: modernist graphic poster, De Stijl orthogonal black grid and asymmetric primary color rectangular planes, crisp Swiss sans-serif typography aligned to grid borders, generous white space, flat matte print finish

recipes.name: Guochao × Minimalism × Editorial
recipes.layout: Generous minimalist negative space framing one refined Chinese cultural motif or character; delicate editorial serif/songti hierarchy.
geometry: restrained traditional seal or ink-stroke focal accent
risks: avoid stacking clichés like dragons, clouds and lattice patterns simultaneously
verify historical accuracy of cultural motifs
recipes.prompt: contemporary neo-Chinese editorial poster, minimalist composition with generous warm rice-paper negative space, restrained cinnabar red seal accent and subtle ink-wash motif, refined calm luxury atmosphere, preserve subject identity

recipes.name: Cyberpunk × Glitch Art × Kinetic Typography
recipes.layout: High-impact futuristic focal character or cityscape with kinetic angled display typography and localized peripheral glitch slices.
geometry: horizontal pixel-slice disruption at frame edges
risks: keep face and eyes completely free of glitch distortion
avoid high-frequency flashing in motion outputs
recipes.prompt: futuristic cyberpunk key visual, dramatic neon cyan and magenta rim lighting on dark night backdrop, dynamic kinetic typography rhythm, localized Glitch Art horizontal pixel slicing at edges only, crisp undistorted facial identity

recipes.name: Bauhaus × Risograph × Editorial
recipes.layout: Bauhaus geometric composition anchored by an editorial column grid and warm analog print margins.
risks: limit spot inks to 3 colors so overprints stay intentional rather than muddy
recipes.prompt: Bauhaus geometric exhibition poster printed in Risograph style, elementary circles triangles and squares, 3-spot fluorescent soy-ink overprint with subtle misregistration, warm uncoated cream paper texture, clean editorial typography grid

recipes.name: Bento Grid × Dark Mode × Glassmorphism
recipes.layout: Modular bento card grid on a low-glare dark charcoal surface; 1–2 hero cards elevated with subtle frosted glass highlights.
geometry: one dominant hero tile with balanced supporting tiles
risks: verify WCAG 2.2 contrast >= 4.5:1 on glass panels
do not make every card translucent
recipes.prompt: modern dark-mode SaaS bento grid UI showcase, modular rounded cards on deep charcoal background, subtle 1px hairline borders, one hero translucent frosted glass card with soft ambient glow, crisp high-contrast hierarchy

recipes.name: Art Deco × Cinematic Photorealism × Luxury
recipes.layout: Monumental centered subject lit with cinematic chiaroscuro, framed by delicate stepped Art Deco geometric borders.
risks: keep metallic gold accents restrained (around 10% initial parameter) to avoid cheap glitter
do not let frame lines cut across the face
recipes.prompt: collector edition luxury poster, cinematic photorealistic chiaroscuro portrait with subtle 35mm film grain, framed by refined Art Deco stepped geometric brass linework on obsidian black and deep emerald backdrop, restrained champagne gold accents

recipes.name: Y2K × Acid Graphics × Vaporwave
recipes.layout: High-energy centered Y2K focal object or character over a dreamy pastel twilight gradient, punctuated by localized liquid-chrome acid graphics.
geometry: liquid chrome organic blobs and star sparkles
palette: pastel pink and twilight violet gradient
risks: limit retro symbols to 1–2 accents to avoid meme-like clutter
keep title legible against metallic reflections
recipes.prompt: Y2K acid-graphics album cover, dreamy vaporwave pastel pink and cyan gradient backdrop, localized liquid chrome typography accents and translucent iridescent shapes, subtle retro scanlines, bold centered silhouette

recipes.name: Japanese Minimalism × Organic × Handdrawn
recipes.layout: Serene Ma negative space with quiet asymmetric balance; a single expressive hand-drawn botanical or character illustration anchors the composition.
risks: stick to one single drawing medium so illustration feels cohesive
use tactile paper grain so minimalism feels warm rather than sterile
recipes.prompt: Japanese minimalist editorial cover, generous serene Ma negative space on warm handmade washi paper, single expressive hand-drawn ink and gouache botanical illustration, muted sage green and terracotta tones, soft diffused natural daylight
